news.title: IPL 2027 retentions out (17 Nov): about 80 players released; Travis Head, Mitchell Starc, Pathirana, Boult, Rachin Ravindra, Avesh Khan among them
news.note: Real lists now, not predictions: powers the Released XI, purse and value stories before the 16 Dec Goa auction.

news.title: Purses left: LSG ₹47.45 cr (7 slots) at the top, GT ₹8.75 cr (3 slots) and RCB ₹14.15 cr at the bottom
news.note: A clean data hook for an auction-needs Lab piece; re-check figures against iplt20.com before building.

news.title: MS Dhoni released from CSK's playing squad; reported as retired as a player and staying on as mentor
news.note: Biggest emotional story of the window. Confirm the official CSK/IPL wording before any 'retired' claim on screen (also reported by cricketaddictor.com).

news.title: Retentions: MI keep Rohit, Bumrah, Suryakumar; RR keep Jaiswal, Sooryavanshi, Jadeja, Archer (Riyan Parag listed as RR captain); MI captaincy still not announced
news.note: MI captain decision is the next IPL news beat; have a Flip/Short ready.

news.title: Gill: India will play four fast bowlers in the 1st Test at the Basin Reserve (starts 19 Nov); Basin 'flattens from day three'; 'no dilemma' over Pant
news.note: A testable captain's claim (myth) plus a fourth-seamer selection puzzle (tactics). Squad seamers: Bumrah, Siraj, Gurnoor Brar, Anshul Kamboj, Akash Deep, Prasidh Krishna.

news.title: Australia v England, 3rd ODI, Hobart, 18 Nov (2:30 pm local) still to be played
news.note: Global-audience filler only; India Test takes priority.

ideas.title: News Short: Dhoni's IPL playing career, closed in one number
ideas.why: Dhoni leaves CSK's playing squad. Open on a single verified career figure (e.g. last-over runs or IPL matches as captain), then three quick beats. Ride the biggest search spike of the window.
ideas.timing: Today or tomorrow morning, once CSK's official wording is confirmed; the story peaks within 48 hours.
ideas.data: Sportmonks IPL 2013-2026 ball-by-ball for death-over and finishing numbers; Cricsheet for 2008-2012; career totals checked against iplt20.com stats.

ideas.title: Flip: Dhoni vs every IPL wicketkeeper, death overs
ideas.why: Benchmark flip: Dhoni's overs 17-20 strike rate against every keeper with a minimum ball count. Visual sign-off for an era.
ideas.timing: Within 2 days of the release news; pairs with the News Short.
ideas.data: Sportmonks IPL 2013-2026 (exclude super overs S3/S4); earlier seasons from Cricsheet, labelled as such.

ideas.title: Stat Check: the Released XI, picked from the real lists
ideas.why: Yesterday's idea, now with the actual releases: Head, Starc, Pathirana, Boult, Rachin, Hasaranga, Nortje, Avesh. Is the best team out of contract better than some retained XIs? Score each XI on recent IPL impact.
ideas.timing: This week, while auction talk builds; before the 23 Nov registration deadline.
ideas.data: Sportmonks IPL 2024-2026 runs/SR/economy by phase; release lists cross-checked with iplt20.com.

ideas.title: Tactics Board: who is India's fourth seamer at the Basin Reserve?
ideas.why: Gill wants a bowler who 'hits the deck'. Compare Akash Deep, Prasidh, Brar and Kamboj on length and bounce profile; field plans labelled illustrative.
ideas.timing: Today, before the toss on 19 Nov (play starts in the early hours IST).
ideas.data: Test match captures (Cricinfo + Cricbuzz) for Akash Deep and Prasidh; first-class figures from official scorecards for Brar and Kamboj; Basin Reserve seam averages from Cricsheet.

ideas.title: Myth or Data?: 'The Basin Reserve flattens from day three'
ideas.why: Gill's own claim. Test it: runs per wicket and seam share of wickets by day at the Basin over the last ten-plus years; stamp busted, half or confirmed.
ideas.timing: During the Test (post day two or three) when the claim is live in commentary.
ideas.data: Cricsheet Test ball-by-ball for Basin Reserve, grouped by day; spot-check totals against official scorecards.

ideas.title: The Lab: who has the hardest auction?
ideas.why: Purse is not the story; need is. Model each team's remaining slots against role gaps (death bowling, overseas opener, spin) left by the releases. GT has ₹8.75 cr for 3 slots, LSG ₹47.45 cr for 7.
ideas.timing: Next week; feeds the 12 Dec auction preview already on the schedule.
ideas.data: Purse/slot table from iplt20.com; role output from Sportmonks IPL 2025-2026 per released and retained player.

ideas.title: Stat Check: was Travis Head worth what SRH paid?
ideas.why: The most surprising release. Powerplay runs above average per season vs his fee, and what SRH's top order looks like without him.
ideas.timing: This week, while the release is fresh.
ideas.data: Sportmonks IPL 2024-2026 powerplay data; fees from official auction records.

ideas.title: Rising Star: Gurnoor Brar, the tall quick in India's Test squad
ideas.why: A possible debut on a seaming Basin pitch. Card back: verified first-class numbers; flip to the bounce angle.
ideas.timing: Post the morning he is named in the XI (or hold for Christchurch if not picked).
ideas.data: Official BCCI/first-class scorecards; Sportmonks IPL for his T20 numbers.

ideas.title: News Short: MI captain announcement, every MI captain's record
ideas.why: MI kept Rohit, Bumrah and Surya but have not named a captain. Prepare the Short now and publish the minute it is announced (reuse the Flip 'Every MI captain vs Rohit' assets).
ideas.timing: Whenever MI announce; have it pre-built.
ideas.data: Sportmonks IPL 2013-2026 captaincy results; official MI announcement.

ideas.title: What If?: Dhoni had walked away after the 2023 title
ideas.why: Sepia counterfactual: CSK's last three seasons with a different keeper-finisher. Different from the scheduled 'What If Dhoni Never Became Captain', but don't post them in the same week.
ideas.timing: Low urgency; slot after the auction.
ideas.data: Sportmonks IPL 2024-2026 for Dhoni's real contribution; replacement-level keeper numbers from the same cache.

ideas.why: RR retained him alongside Jaiswal and Jadeja. His IPL strike rate vs every teenage IPL batter.
ideas.timing: Low urgency; any quiet day before the auction.
